summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of executive director LIU Shihao, effective August 22, 2026. Mr. Liu will continue as CFO with unchanged salary of HK$60,000 per month. The board reduced its size to six members and approved a supplemental employment agreement. No disagreement was cited. The filing is a routine governance update; the director's resignation is not a forced departure, and the CFO role is retained. No financial terms, advisors, or strategic actions are involved. What to watch: any future board or management changes or operational developments.
